verdict.rationale: First-party docs say AnythingLLM runs entirely on your computer with no accounts or API keys and no data leaving the device. Hands-on reports back this up: Ollama was auto-detected, one user called it the only offline AI tool they could install on an office PC, and others praised it as a no-fuss way to run LLMs locally. Missing for 10: documented support for llama.cpp, LM Studio and vLLM as named backends (Ollama is the only one evidenced), and first-party local-backend configuration docs.
